steps: Check projects above the threshold are registered
items.text: Every ongoing project above the RERA threshold registered with the State RERA authority.

steps: Obtain the separate project account statements
Check withdrawals against engineer / architect / CA certificates
items.text: 70% of amounts collected from allottees kept in a separate project account and withdrawn in proportion to completion, with engineer, architect and CA certificates.

steps: Check quarterly updates on the RERA portal
Obtain the annual audited project statement
items.text: Quarterly project updates uploaded; annual audited statement of the project account filed.

steps: Compute construction cost for the year
items.text: Building and other construction workers' cess paid on the cost of construction at the notified rate.

items.ref: Ind AS 115 / AS 9; ICAI Guidance Note on real estate
items.text: Revenue on projects recognised on the correct basis (percentage of completion or completed contract).

steps: Obtain building approvals and occupancy / completion certificates
items.text: Building plan approvals, occupancy and completion certificates obtained.
